ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: Graffiti Framework
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
Your colony gets written on. Bored colonists tag the walls, broken ones go on painting sprees, raiders leave their crew's mark on the way out, and your artists put up whole wall pieces.
Tags, throw-ups, stencils, wheat-paste posters, scrawls, tallies and big multi-colour pieces, all in invented lettering from no real alphabet, painted on the walls themselves. Sigils come from your world: a sigil in your ideoligion's own icon and colour, and a glyph for every meme, each only painted by people who hold it.
Marks matter a little. They carry who made them, and colonists react to a rival's tag differently from a friend's. Own-faction and devotional marks are left alone by the cleaners; order one scrubbed and it goes. Paint a mark yourself with the "Paint graffiti here" order in the Orders tab.
A framework too: any mod can add marks with a ModExtension_Graffiti on a ThingDef, no C# needed. The spree mechanic began as an idea from Graffiti Mod (Continued) by Mlie; this mod replaces it and should not be run beside it. All DLCs are supported and none is required.
